name: Check if permissions defined by a devcontainer have been accepted by the authenticated user
description: Check if permissions defined by a devcontainer have been accepted by the authenticated user Checks whether the permissions defined by a given devcontainer configuration have been accepted by the authenticated user. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/codespaces/permissions_check
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/codespaces/permissions_check
Checks whether the permissions defined by a given devcontainer configuration have been accepted by the authenticated user. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; ref (query) — The git reference that points to the location of the devcontainer configuration to use for the permission check. The value of `ref` will typically be a branch name (`heads/BRANCH_NAME`). For more information, see "[Git References](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-References)" in the Git documentation.; devcontainer_path (query) — Path to the devcontainer.json configuration to use for the permission check.

context:

Lists the devcontainer.json files associated with a specified repository and the authenticated user. These files specify launchpoint configurations for codespaces created within the repository. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `codespace` scope to use this endpoint.
